facts.fact: The Central Bank of Nigeria issued a circular on 15 June 2026 requiring payments transaction data generated in Nigeria to be stored and managed in Nigeria, with full compliance by 1 January 2027, binding all financial institutions and participants facilitating payments.
The circular states the Central Bank of Nigeria shall monitor compliance and may impose supervisory sanctions.
